description:
## Goal

Add audio capabilities to agent-manager so the user can monitor and interact with agent runs via voice.

## Scope

### Voice Input
- Adopt audio-tools voice input components in agent-manager UI
- Support voice commands for common agent-manager operations (stop run, investigate, view status)

### TTS Output
- Adopt audio-tools TTS for reading agent run status updates, investigation summaries, and error reports
- Support summarization for verbose agent outputs

### Configuration
- Add audio settings section to agent-manager settings
- Pass provider preferences through to audio-tools

## Key Considerations

- Agent-manager's audio use case is monitoring agent health and responding to issues while mobile
- TTS should be able to read investigation reports and run summaries in a concise, actionable way
- Lower priority than web-console and swarm-manager adoption since agent-manager interaction is less frequent during walks
name: agent-manager-adopt-audio-tools
title: Integrate Audio-Tools into Agent-Manager UI
